provenance.summary: The GLASS Router's arm-internal configuration for the PR 38 primary outer-fold routers: per-rule quality gates, rule counts, depth-2 pruning, overlap, novelty, complexity and diversity settings, and the RF feature ranker. None of these is a contract obligation, but each shapes GLASS coverage, so they are fixed before any corrected result. The union obligations are not part of this profile: they come only from the frozen shared contract (glass_config_from_contract).
provenance.derivation: The legacy profile behind the historical GLASS artifacts, preserved exactly, with three changes and nothing else: (1) max_union_leakage_rate_pass1 (legacy 0.14) is removed from the profile, because every union obligation comes from the contract (0.15 under the frozen contract); (2) pass2_population, pass1_oof_folds, random_state, remainder_min_size and inner_feature_ranker are the F17 primary (legacy pass2_population 'full' remains the S1 sensitivity only); (3) the Pass 2 union objective is 'rows', set by the contract adapter. lambda_rf_uncertainty and lambda_rf_misalignment stay unset, as in the legacy profile: the ILP's defaults (0.15 / 0.08) act as a tie-break only. The ranker's glass_rf_model 'fold_rf' and rf_params are the historical cross-fit settings (Cell 14: rf_params = rf_result.params).
provenance.tuning: Not tuned for the shared contract. The legacy gates were set by hand in PRs 33-36 with historical out-of-fold results visible; the ranker's RF hyperparameters were tuned once (Optuna TPE, seed 42, 200 trials, 5-fold ROC-AUC on all of X_eng_train).
exposure: The legacy profile was chosen with historical out-of-fold results visible (F17 limitation L3).
The ranker's hyperparameter tuning saw all training rows and target-encoded features informed by its own validation labels.
Fixed before any corrected PR 38 result existed; the 'recommended' preset in the notebook was not run in the historical baseline and is not this profile.
limitations: The per-rule gates are candidate filters, not union compliance: every obligation is enforced on the selected union by the ILP.

A legacy gate looser than its union obligation (min_precision_subscribe 0.20 against the union precision floor 0.30) only widens the candidate pool; a stricter one (per-rule leakage 0.05) can narrow it and reduce feasible coverage.
GLASS feasibility under these settings is first observed at the PR 38 fit-only preflight (G3); an infeasible preflight stops and needs a new version (M4), never a silent change.
provenance.relation_to_pr38: PR 38 builds every primary GLASS config with glass_router.profile.glass_primary_config(contract): this frozen profile (pinned fingerprint) plus the frozen contract's union obligations, and passes ranker_settings() to the cross-fit. A different value needs a new profile version, approval and disclosure before corrected outer out-of-fold results are inspected.
